headline: OpenAI disbands its Preparedness team; Conquerors and Zookeeper edge up
body: One story set the tone today. CNBC reported that OpenAI has dissolved its Preparedness team, the group that graded frontier models for cyber and bio risk, amid executive departures ahead of a reported IPO. The index reads that as a setback for Alignment & Control: fewer people inside a leading lab whose job is to spot dangerous capabilities before release. Weaker control lifts the darker AI-takeover paths, Conquerors (AI turns on us) and Zookeeper (AI keeps us as pets), and nudges Self-Destruction, while every ending that depends on safe AI slipped, Protector God most of all. Horizon Balance fell from -0.81 to -1.55. The shuffle also produced crossovers: Descendants moved above Gatekeeper, and Zookeeper passed Protector God.
movers_note: Protector God -0.6, mostly from OpenAI disbanding Preparedness (-0.56). Gatekeeper -0.5, mostly from OpenAI disbanding Preparedness (-0.48). Conquerors +0.5, from OpenAI disbanding Preparedness (+0.56), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05).
